title: FPS3's work arms again, with the hauling sustained: FPS3 (run 202403) laid one stockpile beside the loose items and the fort filled it in ~1,000 ticks (28 working -> 6), so its work arms failed the kill criterion. Here `cx-load rework` moves the stockpile >= 50 tiles at every 1,000-tick sample, so everything is hauled across the map again (probe: 27/25/11/28 working). Idle vs working, 29 vs 89 citizens, on a freshly started DF.
fork: What a working citizen costs next to an idle one.

predictions.model: working dwarves cost more than idle ones
predictions.expects: W1 below W0, and W3-W1 larger than W2-W0

kill_criterion: a work arm whose mean working count over samples 2+ is under 15 did not keep the fort at work
culling: the first sample step of every replicate (warm-up, load-time caches)
